extDesc.message: Warns you when a website looks like a scam: new domains, brand impersonation, phishing forms, money-fraud wording and chat scams.

banner_danger_title.message: This website is likely a scam

banner_danger_sub.message: Do not enter passwords, card numbers or personal details here.

banner_warn_sub.message: Be careful before entering any personal or payment information.

btn_trust_tip.message: Never warn again for this domain

sb_disclaimer.message: Google cannot guarantee its information is complete or error-free.

chat_title.message: This conversation matches a known scam pattern

popup_cannot_analyse.message: This page cannot be analysed (browser page, local address or file).

popup_trusted_allowlist.message: You chose to trust this domain.

popup_ok_clean.message: Risk score $1/100. Nothing suspicious was detected, but stay alert: no tool catches every scam.

opt_intro.message: All analysis runs locally in your browser. The only network requests are the optional lookups described below.

opt_danger_label.message: Show the red "likely scam" banner at risk score ≥

opt_warn_label.message: Show the amber "suspicious" banner at risk score ≥

opt_show_warn.message: Show the amber banner (the toolbar badge always shows the score)

opt_rdap_toggle.message: Look up when a domain was registered (RDAP)

opt_rdap_p.message: Sends the site's domain name (never the full URL) to rdap.org, which redirects to the registry's public RDAP service. Results are cached for 7 days. Freshly registered domains are one of the strongest scam indicators, so this is on by default.

opt_feed_toggle.message: Keep a local copy of PhishTank's verified phishing reports and warn when a page or site is in it

opt_feed_p.message: A list of about 50,000 community-reported, verified phishing addresses is downloaded from data.phishtank.com a few times a day (about 2 MB each time) and stored on this device as hashes. Pages are matched locally: the addresses you visit are never sent anywhere. Reports are community data and are not guaranteed to be accurate.

opt_feed_key.message: PhishTank application key (optional, raises the download limit; get one at phishtank.org):

opt_sb_toggle.message: Also ask Google Safe Browsing about each page

opt_sb_p.message: Off by default. When on, the full address of every page you open is sent to Google's Safe Browsing Lookup service using your own API key (create one in Google Cloud, enable the Safe Browsing API and restrict the key to this extension). Google's terms allow non-commercial use only. Results are cached for up to 30 minutes.

opt_sb_notice.message: Google works to provide the most accurate and up-to-date information about unsafe web resources. However, Google cannot guarantee that its information is comprehensive and error-free: some risky sites may not be identified, and some safe sites may be identified in error. Warnings based on this data are marked "Advisory provided by Google".

opt_chat_toggle.message: Watch conversations on selling sites (OLX, Vinted, Wallapop, Leboncoin, Marktplaats, eBay, Facebook Marketplace, Idealista…) for known scam scripts

opt_chat_p.message: Off by default. When on, chat text on those sites is checked locally (nothing is sent anywhere) for schemes such as "I'll send a courier, click the link to receive the payment", "forward me the SMS code", "the payment is held until you pay the insurance", "send the deposit before the viewing" or overpayment refunds, in English, Portuguese, Spanish and French. A banner explains the scheme when one appears.

opt_chat_domains.message: Extra sites to monitor (one domain per line):

opt_trusted_p.message: Domains you have chosen to trust are never flagged.

opt_brands_p.message: One per line: Brand name | keyword1, keyword2 | realdomain.com, other.com. Keywords are matched inside hostnames; real domains are never flagged. Useful for your bank, employer or local services.

sig_ip_host.message: Site is addressed by a raw IP address instead of a domain name

sig_idn.message: Internationalised domain name (non-Latin characters) can hide look-alike letters

sig_risky_tld.message: .$1 is a top-level domain heavily used for abuse

sig_host_keywords.message: Hostname contains words typical of phishing links

sig_hyphens_many.message: Unusually many hyphens in the domain

sig_deep_subdomain.message: Deeply nested subdomains (often used to hide the real domain)

sig_seed_phrase.message: Page asks for a crypto wallet seed / recovery phrase or private key

sig_cred_lookalike.message: Login form on a domain impersonating $1

sig_cred_young.message: Login form on a very recently registered domain

sig_cred_free_host.message: Login form hosted on a free hosting / sandbox service

sig_cred_ip.message: Login form on a raw IP address

sig_card_lookalike.message: Card-details form on a domain impersonating $1

sig_card_young.message: Card-details form on a very recently registered domain

sig_card_free_host.message: Card-details form hosted on a free hosting service

sig_cross_domain_form.message: Credentials are submitted to a different domain

sig_http_form.message: Credentials are submitted over unencrypted HTTP

sig_get_form.message: Password is sent in the URL (GET form)

sig_brand_title.message: Page presents itself as $1 but is not on a $1 domain

sig_brand_body.message: Page repeatedly mentions $1 next to a credential form

sig_brand_favicon.message: Favicon is loaded from $1's real site

sig_brand_assets.message: Logos/styles hot-linked from $1's real site on a credential page

sig_dead_links.message: Most links on the page go nowhere (fake navigation)

sig_link_mismatch.message: Links display one address but lead to another

sig_no_context_menu.message: Right-click is disabled on a credential page

sig_frames.message: Many third-party frames on a credential page

sig_money_form.message: Asks for card or account details next to money claims

sig_money_stack.message: Several independent money-scam templates on one page

sig_money_young_new.message: Money claims on a very recently registered site

sig_money_young_free.message: Money claims on a free-hosting site

sig_phish_report_url.message: Reported and verified as a phishing page by the PhishTank community

sig_phish_report_host_one.message: This site has 1 verified phishing report on PhishTank

sig_phish_report_host_many.message: This site has $1 verified phishing reports on PhishTank

sig_safe_browsing.message: Google Safe Browsing lists this page as a $1

sb_type_unwanted.message: site that may install unwanted software

phrase_microfee.message: Tiny "processing fee" asking for card details

phrase_advancefee.message: Advance fee demanded to release money

phrase_escrow.message: Fake escrow / payment held by a third party

det_no_https_cred.message: and the page asks for credentials or card details

det_seed.message: No legitimate service ever asks for this

ev_contains.message: hostname contains "$1" but is not a $2 domain

chat_courier_pickup_title.message: Buyer wants to send a courier and pay remotely

chat_courier_pickup_advice.message: Classic OLX/Vinted scam: the "courier" or "delivery service" is fake and the payment link steals your card details. Only use the platform's own delivery and payment flow.

chat_payment_link_title.message: Asked to open a link or enter card details to "receive" money

chat_payment_link_advice.message: Nobody needs your card number, CVV or a link to pay you. Real platform payouts go to the account you already set up. Do not open the link.

chat_fee_to_release_title.message: Payment "held" until you pay a fee or insurance

chat_fee_to_release_advice.message: Money that is "blocked until you pay insurance / transport / a verification fee" does not exist. The fee is the scam.

chat_sms_code_title.message: Asked to forward a verification code

chat_sms_code_advice.message: The code is being used to take over an account (WhatsApp, Google Voice, the marketplace itself) in your name. Never share codes you receive by SMS.

chat_overpayment_advice.message: The original payment is fake or will be reversed; any "difference" you send back is lost.

chat_abroad_title.message: Counterpart claims to be abroad / unable to meet

chat_abroad_advice.message: Buyers or sellers who "cannot come in person" and will handle everything remotely are a common scam setup. Prefer in-person handover or the platform's delivery.

chat_off_platform_title.message: Pushing the conversation off the platform

chat_off_platform_advice.message: Scammers move to WhatsApp, Telegram or email so the platform cannot see or block them. Keep the conversation and the payment inside the platform.

chat_pay_first_title.message: Payment demanded upfront through an untraceable channel

chat_pay_first_advice.message: Deposits by bank transfer, MB WAY, Bizum, PayPal "friends and family", gift cards or crypto before you have the item cannot be recovered. Use the platform's protected payment or pay on collection.

chat_rental_deposit_title.message: Rental: deposit requested before any viewing

chat_rental_deposit_advice.message: Never pay a deposit, "reservation" or first month before visiting the property and meeting the landlord. Keys "sent by courier" or payments "handled by Airbnb/Booking" for a classified ad are a scam.

chat_fake_payment_proof_title.message: Fake payment confirmation or "upgrade to receive"

chat_fake_payment_proof_advice.message: Screenshots of "completed transfers" are easily faked, and no bank or platform requires a business account or an upgrade to receive a payment. Check your own account balance, not their screenshot.

chat_pressure_advice.message: Urgency is used to stop you from thinking. Take your time and verify.

chat_phishing_link_advice.message: "$1" is not a real $2 address. Opening it will lead to a fake payment or login page.

chat_external_link_title.message: External link sent alongside payment or delivery talk

chat_external_link_advice.message: Links to $1 should not be needed to pay or ship. Stay on the platform.
